videos.main-main-content-every-video-her: Every video here is hosted on YouTube by the channel that made it - we did not produce them and cannot vouch for every word in every report. Where a video tells a miracle story, our own pages keep the careful distinctions: what the Church has formally recognized, what is recorded at the monastery, and what remains a personal testimony. Embeds use youtube-nocookie.com, using YouTube's privacy-enhanced embed mode.
videos.main-main-content-what-videos-are: What videos are on this page?
videos.main-main-content-documentaries-o: Documentaries on Saint Charbel's life, from a short ten-minute film to a full eighty-minute documentary, the complete feature film with English subtitles, the older six-part film, miracle reports, and footage from Annaya and the relic tours.
videos.main-main-content-are-the-videos-: Are the videos hosted on this site?
videos.main-main-content-no-they-are-emb: No. They are embedded from YouTube through the youtube-nocookie player, using YouTube's privacy-enhanced embed mode.
videos.main-main-content-can-i-watch-the: Can I watch the full Saint Charbel movie here?
videos.main-main-content-yes-the-full-fe: Yes. The full feature film about Saint Charbel's life, with English subtitles, is embedded on this page - about one hour and forty-four minutes.
